title: Export profiles, parallel export, and real progress

do: 导出区提供草稿、标准、最终、高速最终 profile，并显示分辨率/fps/parallel 摘要
nf export 暴露 --profile、--fps、--resolution、--parallel、--events 参数
shell export.start 接收 profile/fps/resolution/parallel，并把参数传给 nf export
前端 inspector 使用真实 progress 字段显示进度条、帧数、阶段和 ETA
最终导出仍从保存后的 composition JSON 编译 source sidecar
do_not: 不换 WebView/CARenderer/VideoToolbox 截图导出架构
不改 v2 composition JSON 轨道语法
不引入 iframe、React、Vue 或 Electron

verify_points.text: 桌面端导出区能选择多个 profile，并显示每个 profile 的 resolution/fps/parallel。
导出运行中 export.status 和前端 UI 显示真实 percent/frames/stage/ETA。
高速最终档把 parallel 参数传到 recorder，并能触发 parallel 或明确短视频降级原因。
任一 profile 导出都使用保存后的 composition JSON source，导出 sidecar 能看到最新编辑。
导出成功后桌面端继续显示输出路径和打开视频按钮。

ai_tools.command: target/debug/nf export --project v2-showcase --composition launch-open --profile draft --out tmp/v0.11.0/launch-draft.mp4

items.title: Stream export progress into shell job state

ai_tools.expected: export job starts and status includes running progress
JSON contains progress.percent, frames_encoded, total_frames, stage

items.title: Inspector export profile controls and progress UI

ai_tools.expected: right inspector shows profile controls and numeric progress text

items.title: Wire final-fast profile to recorder parallel slicing

ai_tools.command: target/debug/nf export --project v2-showcase --composition showreel-24s --profile final-fast --parallel 4 --out tmp/v0.11.0/showreel-final-fast.mp4 --events
ai_tools.expected: stdout shows record.parallel.start or a structured downgrade reason

items.title: Saved JSON remains the only export source

poc_decision: N/A: recorder parallel slicing and stdout events already exist in nf-recorder. This version wires existing capabilities into nf export, shell IPC, and frontend UI, with benchmark verification during build.
